lines.slot: Hook, first 2 seconds: what the viewer gets from this feature, in one sentence.
lines.text: [confident, full voice] Remind every customer before their *booking*.

lines.slot: Step: where the feature lives. Name every button exactly as the screen writes it.
Step: one action per line, then a short pause: viewers cannot scroll back.
Step: the choice the viewer makes, read from the screen.
lines.text: [explaining] Choose *when* they go out. Say, *one hour* before.

lines.slot: Show the other side: what the customer, the guest or the teammate sees.
lines.text: [explaining] Here is the message your customer gets.

lines.slot: Step: the button that confirms, named as the screen writes it.
Result: what is now true, in plain words. Claim only what the product does today.
lines.text: [clear, full voice] From now on, every booking gets its reminder.

lines.slot: Brand close: your name and your one short line, spoken over the end card.
lines.text: [upbeat, not over the top] *Your Brand*. One short line.
